one_line: Open on the finished row of gifts with a line that names the parent, then build one box.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 static wide shot of white window gift boxes in a row. Sung music, no speech. Text, three lines and a heart: "החלטת להכין לבד את המתנות לאורחים לחאלקה של הילד שלך". 0:01 a hand spoons spice into a jar.
q1_hook.why: The second-person line names the exact parent who is planning this event (H1, T3, K7), and the finished boxes in the first frame show the payoff (H2, R4). Hands start work at 1 s (S1). No face or voice, but there is music (H4, H6).

beats.what: Row of finished boxes; a hand spoons spice into a jar, then ties twine on it; headline text
beats.why: Result and the first step in one go

beats.what: Matches loaded into a glass vial from a matchbox; a match is lit; vial tied with twine
beats.why: A second item, with a small flame for visual interest

beats.what: A printed booklet "סדר הבדלה מזמור לתודה" with the child's name and date; pages flipped
beats.why: The personal item is shown up close

beats.what: A ribbon with a small flower tied round the booklet; white paper shred in the box
beats.why: The finishing touch gets its own beat

beats.what: A two-tone green and white candle out of its box; candle, jars and booklet placed in the box
beats.why: The box fills, so the viewer sees the full contents

beats.what: The packed box from above, then closed; three boxes with windows
Wide shot of the row of boxes, like the first frame
beats.why: Closes the loop and shows the quantity

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: comment on the Reel and the full list with links and the booklet text is sent automatically. No question or tag ask.
q2_flow.why: A new item or action every few seconds with a finished-gift payoff gives a clear arc (K2, R3), and the last shot returns to the first (R4). Close hands doing something new each time keep the picture moving (E2). A gift idea a parent would send to a friend planning the same event (R5).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption, line 3: "מי שרוצה את הרשימה המלאה עם לינקים לכל מה שהזמנתי + הברכון עם הברכות, שתגיב לי על הרילס וזה יישלח אליה אוטומטית".
q3_cta.why: One action, comment, with a concrete reward, the shopping list with links and greeting text, which suits an automated reply (C1, C2, C3). Any comment works, so no keyword is needed. But it appears only in the caption below "more", never said or shown in the video (against C6).

q4_shown.what: The finished boxes at 0:00 and 0:34-0:36; hands only: a spice jar, a matches vial, a lit match, a booklet with the child's name and date 0:12-0:21, a ribbon, a candle, the box packed 0:24-0:33. No face or price.
q4_shown.why: Result first, then each part added, so the viewer sees the full contents and the effort (R3, K2). The booklet cover with the child's name and date is held still for about 4 s, the personalising closest to LumeBook's own (S2, S8). No face or reaction is shown (S4, K8).

q5_edit.what: About 20 shots in 37 s (first-pass estimate, about 1.8 s each), mostly straight cuts between close-ups of hands, one pan at 0:33-0:34 to a wide shot. Text only 0:00-0:04. Sung music, no speech. Ends on a wide shot like the first frame.
q5_edit.why: A new close-up every 1 to 3 s with new hand action keeps a calm Reel moving (E2, R3). The sung psalm line suits the booklet's title, but its licence is unknown (E5). After 0:04 the pictures work alone (T1). The ending loops to the first frame (R4, E8).

q6_topic.what: A mother makes personalised Havdalah gift boxes for guests at her son's first-haircut ceremony; it serves parents planning a family event who want a gift idea and a shopping list.
q6_topic.why: A life event with a clear buyer and occasion (K7), a visible, copyable gift (R5), and a warm personal note in the caption (K1, K6). The list of links behind the comment is what a planning parent wants (R7).

q7_filmed.what: A static wide shot of the finished boxes on a sideboard in daylight; handheld close-ups of hands against a white wall and a plant; a medium shot over the box; a pan to the row of boxes. Soft, white palette. No face or child.
q7_filmed.why: Close hands against a plain wall show each item clearly (F4, F5, S4). The soft white look is calm and homemade (F7, H8). Some shots at 0:12-0:17 are dim and slightly blurred (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: 0:00-0:04 three centred lines, white bold handwriting-style font with a white heart, about 19 to 36 percent down: "החלטת להכין לבד", "את המתנות לאורחים", "לחאלקה של הילד שלך". No other text; the booklet's own printed title and the child's name and date show in the frames.
q8_text.caption: "אין לי דרך להסביר כמה אני מתרגשת🤍". 30 words in two short paragraphs: a feeling, then the comment-for-the-list ask. No hashtags, no question, no disclosure.
q8_text.why: The headline is readable, inside the safe zone and speaks to the right parent in the first second (T3, T4, K7), but it is gone at 0:05 and nothing else explains the shots (T1). The caption opens with a feeling, not searchable words, has no hashtags, and puts the ask in line 3 (T7, C6).

weak_points: No ask in the video, only below "more"; no hashtags; the text is gone at 0:05; dim, blurry shots at 0:12-0:17; no price or item sources on screen; the child's name and date readable on the booklet.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on the finished packed gift with a line to the buyer, then film the book's name page in hand for 2 s or more, with one comment-for-the-link ask.
not_verified: Whether the audio is licensed or a trending sound. What the automation sends beyond what the caption says. The sources of the items. What the lit match at 0:09-0:10 is for. The child's name and date are readable on the booklet and are not written here. Correction: the first pass says music likely; the transcript shows sung psalm words ("מזמור לתודה"), so it is a song with lyrics, and there is no speech.
